versions.content: Combine dataReceivePointByValue or dataReceive- PointByArgument with a WaitPoint In general, it is possible to combine a dataReceivePointByValue or dataReceivePointByArgument with a Wait- Point in the scope of a particular RunnableEntity . This allows for a call to a blocking receive routine implemented by the RTE. The time- out attribute of meta-class WaitPoint can be used to specify the time until the block- ing call expires. But in case of non-queued communication it is not supported that a DataRe- ceivedEvent is used in combination with a WaitPoint (see [constr_2021]). This contradicts the approach of the last-is-best semantics.
